en-US.description:
Turn any text, screenshot, flyer, or photo into a calendar event in seconds. Add to Calendar reads the details with AI — title, date, time, and location — and hands you a ready-to-save event. Stop typing event info by hand.

HOW IT WORKS
• Paste or type text — "Lunch with Sam Friday 12:30 at Blue Bottle"
• Or pick a screenshot / snap a photo of a flyer, invite, ticket, or email
• AI pulls out the event details
• Tap once to save it to your Apple Calendar, or open it in Google Calendar

PERFECT FOR
• Screenshots of concert, class, or appointment details
• Event flyers and posters
• Email and message invites
• Conference and meeting agendas
• Tickets and booking confirmations

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Sign in with Apple or Google — or skip the account entirely and use your own OpenAI API key
• Your API key is stored only in the iOS Keychain and never leaves your device except to reach OpenAI
• No ads, no third-party tracking, no selling your data
• Delete your account right inside the app

PRICING
• Free: sign in and extract events from text — 50 per month
• Bring your own OpenAI key for unlimited extractions and image (screenshot/photo) scanning

Add to Calendar is the fastest way to get what's in front of you onto your calendar.
en-US.releaseNotes:
You asked, we shipped — both features in this update came from launch-week user requests:
• Recurring events: “team standup every Tuesday” now becomes a repeating calendar event (weekly, monthly, custom intervals, end dates)
• Choose your calendar: pick which calendar events are saved to (home/work/school) in Settings

review.notes:
This app extracts calendar events from text or images using AI. Sign-in is optional.

To test the full flow (no test account needed):
1. Settings tab → "Sign in with Apple" → authenticate with your own Apple ID.
   This creates an account with 50 free extractions/month.
2. Home screen → paste event text, e.g.:
   "Team standup tomorrow 10:00-10:30am at HQ"
   then extract. The parsed event appears; tap to add it to your calendar.
3. Image extraction: pick a photo of an event flyer/poster instead of text.
4. Adding an event uses the native iOS calendar (permission prompt on first
   use) or a Google Calendar web link — no calendar account required.

Account deletion (5.1.1(v)): Settings → "Delete account" permanently deletes
the account and all data, and revokes Sign in with Apple tokens.

Alternative: users may instead enter their own OpenAI API key in Settings and
use the app with no sign-in at all.
